_comment: Settings for the encounter builder's difficulty guide (app/encounter_guide.py). These are rough, editable defaults chosen for this app - NOT published rules from any game book. 'pressure' compares the foes' (attacks x hit points x damage) with the party's, which is Lanchester's square law for a straight fight. A band applies while pressure is at or below 'max'. Edit freely; restart the app to pick up changes.

foe_hits.label: About the same as the party's

bands.label: Easy
bands.text: The party should win quickly and barely notice.

bands.label: Fair
bands.text: A real fight the party should win, spending some resources.

bands.label: Hard
bands.text: The party probably wins, but badly hurt; someone could go down.

bands.label: Deadly
bands.text: On even terms the foes win. The party needs tactics, terrain, surprise or a way out.

bands.label: Overwhelming
bands.text: A straight fight is hopeless. Make sure the players have a way to see that coming and run.

rifts.label: Rifts
notes: Rifts mixes S.D.C. and M.D.C. One M.D.C. point is worth 100 S.D.C. Add mdc to a foe line, or tick M.D.C. for a party member, whenever the number is mega-damage capacity.

Ordinary S.D.C. weapons generally cannot hurt M.D.C. targets at all, and a mega-damage hit is worth 100 times as much against S.D.C. targets. This guide only converts hit points, so check what each side's weapons actually do.
Magic, psionics, vehicles, power armor and robot bonuses are not counted; they swing Rifts fights a lot.

palladium_fantasy.label: Palladium Fantasy
notes: Enter hit points (plus S.D.C. where your edition uses it) as one number.
Armor Rating, spells, psionics, and supernatural monsters are not counted. Use 'how hard the foes hit' to show a big gap in damage.

heroes_unlimited.label: Heroes Unlimited
notes: Add hit points and S.D.C. together as one number. Super-powers such as force fields, energy blasts and invulnerability are not counted.
Power levels vary enormously between heroes; use 'how hard the foes hit' to show a big gap in damage.

palladium.label: Palladium games
notes: Enter hit points (and S.D.C. where the game uses it) as one number. Games with mega-damage can mark a group mdc; one M.D.C. point is worth 100 S.D.C.
Armor, magic and psionics are not counted.

d20.label: D&D and d20 games
notes: This is not the books' encounter-building rules. For D&D and other d20 games, the official XP budget or challenge rating guidance is more accurate; use this only as a quick comparison.
Spells, saving throws, armor class and conditions are not counted.

generic.label: Other games
notes: A plain comparison of hit points and attacks per round. Armor, special abilities and magic are not counted.
